## Summary

Describe the student-facing change and why it is needed.

## Source and consistency

- [ ] The change matches the current information on Canvas or was explicitly approved by an instructor.
- [ ] Dates, links, filenames, and wording have been checked against the source.
- [ ] If Canvas and this site differ, the pull request identifies the difference for instructor review.

## Privacy and publication check

- [ ] No student records, grades, submissions, unpublished assessments, or internal documents are included.
- [ ] No personal contact information is included unless it is intentionally public.
- [ ] The page was checked locally on both a desktop-sized and mobile-sized screen.
